newsitem.title: USA: 3Com hits tech sector, more losses seen.
newsitem.headline: 3Com hits tech sector, more losses seen.

text.p: Technology shares were pummeled by a sharp drop in 3Com Corp, as investors wondered whether the recent surge in technology is over amid analyst expectation of a further downtick in the sector.
Earlier on Monday, 3Com said that its third quarter earnings would fall short of Wall Street estimates, fueling a 26 percentage drop in its stock. 3Com fell 13-1/2 to 37-1/4.

"I think it's going to spread from here," said David Takata, an analyst with Gruntal & Co. "The networking sector has been the leader in technology for three years. PC sales are just ok, and networking has been booming."
